💡 cad-skill | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable users to easily design and generate custom 3D-printable parts through natural language interaction with an AI assistant, powered by CadQuery for parametric modeling.
✨ Key Features: • Parametric 3D model generation using CadQuery • Integration with Claude Code for natural language interaction • Automatic script generation based on user descriptions • STL export and rendered previews • Iterative design process with AI assistance
📖 Summary: This repository provides a Claude Code skill that leverages CadQuery to generate parametric 3D-printable models. Users can describe a desired object, and the skill will automatically write the CadQuery script, export an STL file, and provide previews, allowing for iterative refinement.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 Podroid | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Running Linux environments, including containers and desktop applications, on an Android device without root privileges.
✨ Key Features: • Run Podman, Docker, and LXC containers • Full Alpine Linux VM with custom kernel or AVF • In-app terminal with extensive customization • X11 desktop environment for GUI apps • USB passthrough, SSH, and port forwarding
📖 Summary: Podroid is a rootless Android application that allows users to run a full Alpine Linux virtual machine directly on their device. It supports containerization tools like Podman, Docker, and LXC, as well as GUI Linux applications, all without requiring root access.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 MoneyPrinterTurbo | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate short-form videos (e.g., for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) based on user-provided topics or keywords, streamlining content creation.
✨ Key Features: • Automated video script generation • AI-powered material matching • Subtitle generation • Background music integration • HD short video synthesis
📖 Summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an automated AI tool that generates high-definition short videos from a given topic or keyword. It handles the entire workflow, from scriptwriting and material matching to subtitle generation and final video synthesis.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 scroll-world | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating unique, interactive, and visually engaging brand landing pages that simulate a 'fly-through' experience.
✨ Key Features: • Generates immersive, scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages • AI-driven scene and camera flight generation • Seamless camera transitions between scenes (no cuts) • Framework-agnostic vanilla-JS scrub engine • Optional mobile-optimized 9:16 portrait version
📖 Summary: This repository provides a skill for AI agents like Claude Code and Codex to generate immersive, scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages for brands. It uses AI to create scenes and camera flights, allowing users to experience a continuous, fly-through narrative as they scroll.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
